context: A police officer briefs a teen reporter on a foreign-trade case
purpose: Teach: 県民/中年/日本国/同志/アラブ/モンゴル/高価/形状

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 今回の事件はね、日本国とアラブ諸国を結ぶルートが絡んでいる。
lines.en: This case involves a route linking Japan and the Arab nations.
lines.style: Authoritative officer opening the briefing, calm and measured tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: えっ、アラブまでですか?
lines.en: What, all the way to the Arab world?
lines.style: Eager teen reporter, curious and slightly breathless reaction.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: ああ。容疑者は中年の男性でね。
lines.en: Yes. The suspect is a middle-aged man.
lines.style: Officer parceling out facts deliberately, professional restraint.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 中年男性…どこから入ってきたんですか?
lines.en: A middle-aged man... where did the goods come in from?
lines.style: Teen pressing gently for more details, taking notes.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: モンゴル経由だ。品物がね、なかなか厄介でね。
lines.en: Via Mongolia. The goods themselves were quite a problem.
lines.style: Officer giving details in measured beats, lowered voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Sharp follow-up from the teen, leaning forward attentively.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 高価な工芸品でね、形状が独特で税関でも見抜けなかった。
lines.en: Expensive crafts whose unusual shape slipped past customs.
lines.style: Officer explaining the key technical detail, gravely professional.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: なるほど、共犯はいるんですか?
lines.style: Teen reporter probing further, notebook in hand.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: そこはまだ言えない。同志社大学出身という点だけ伝えておくよ。
lines.en: I can't say yet. I'll just mention he's a Doshisha University graduate.
lines.style: Officer holding back details appropriately, measured caution.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わかりました、県民に伝わるよう書きます。
lines.en: Understood, I'll write it so the prefecture's people grasp it.
lines.style: Teen reporter closing out the interview, sincere but grounded.
